The standard-library checker ran 394670 finite corroborating checks; no infinite claim rests on finite tests.

value.rationale: Perimetral equal-chord circle rigidity is an established geometric question with open global odd-denominator cases >=7. Simultaneous local rigidity for all such fractions, via an exact algebraic nonresonance theorem, is a structurally motivated boundary result rather than a numerical instance. The sharp loss of one derivative measures intrinsic inverse conditioning and provides testable analytical stability for near-circle shapes. No global result is claimed.
